title: Zero Work along a Closed Elliptical Loop
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the work done by F = grad(x^2 + y^2) around the ellipse x^2/4 + y^2/9 = 1.

steps.title: Apply Closed Loop Theorem for Gradient Fields
steps.explanation: Because F is conservative and C is a closed loop returning to its starting point, initial and terminal states coincide.
